description: Add-transaction form Phase-2 changes (plan items 1 & 2), both in lib/presentation/screens/add_transaction/add_transaction_screen.dart. Item 1: group OPTIONAL/advanced fields (Payment method + Account, Note, Tags, Location, Receipt) behind a single collapsible 'Add details' disclosure — collapsed by default for NEW transactions, EXPANDED by default when editing. Item 2: add an optional SmsPrefill parameter so a detected SMS can open the shared form pre-filled, without breaking the initialType/editTransaction callers. Independent of FEAT-003; FEAT-002 depends on this feature's SmsPrefill type + AddTransactionScreen param, so this goes first.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/mykhata-phase2-ux/context.json and this file FIRST, then plan.md decisions D1 and D2. Read add_transaction_screen.dart fully.

Item 1 disclosure: add `bool _detailsExpanded` to _AddTransactionScreenState; in initState set `_detailsExpanded = widget.editTransaction != null`. Wrap the existing Payment-method block (`if (_type != 'transfer') ...[ Payment method SegmentedTabs + Account dropdown ]`) and the existing Note/Tags/Location/Receipt spread into one collapsible region. The region is: a tappable 'Add details' header row built from Pressable + AppText + a chevron Icon that flips (Icons.expand_more_rounded / expand_less_rounded) using context.palette, followed by AnimatedSize(duration: AppMotion.fast, curve: AppMotion.enter) whose child is a Column of those fields when _detailsExpanded else const SizedBox(width: double.infinity) — mirror the existing _SmsCardState._showOriginal pattern in sms_review_screen.dart.

Keep every inner conditional unchanged: Payment method + Account only render when `_type != 'transfer'`, Account hidden when `_selectedPaymentMethod == 'Cash'`. For transfer the disclosure body holds only Note/Tags/Location/Receipt. Amount, type, description/From, category/To and Date stay OUTSIDE the disclosure (always visible). Do NOT reset _selectedPaymentMethod (stays 'UPI'), _noteController, _selectedTags, _receipts, or _locationResult when collapsing — collapsing only hides widgets. Do NOT change _saveTransaction field assembly for item 1.

Item 2 SmsPrefill: add an immutable class `SmsPrefill` (final fields: String type; double amount; String? description; String paymentMethod (default 'UPI'); DateTime date; String? accountId; String? smsMessageId; String? externalReference) — define it in add_transaction_screen.dart (top-level) or an adjacent small file, exported for sms_review_screen.dart to import.
Add `final SmsPrefill? smsPrefill;` to AddTransactionScreen with a const constructor param defaulting to null; keep existing initialType and editTransaction params and their behavior intact.

In initState, AFTER the existing editTransaction prefill block, add: `if (widget.editTransaction == null && widget.smsPrefill != null) { seed _type = smsPrefill.type.toLowerCase(); _amountController.text = formatted amount; _descriptionController.text = smsPrefill.description ?? ''; _selectedPaymentMethod = smsPrefill.paymentMethod; _selectedDate = smsPrefill.date; }`. Store smsPrefill.accountId so _effectiveAccount resolves it (e.g. seed _selectedAccount by looking it up once accounts are available, or add it to the account resolution chain) — keep _effectiveAccount's existing precedence otherwise. Autofocus logic stays: amount autofocuses only when editTransaction == null (prefilled SMS entries may keep autofocus; do not special-case).

In _saveTransaction, when `widget.editTransaction == null && widget.smsPrefill != null`, pass `source: 'sms'`, `smsMessageId: widget.smsPrefill!.smsMessageId`, `externalReference: widget.smsPrefill!.externalReference` into the constructed TransactionModel (today source defaults to 'manual'). Change the success-path `Navigator.pop(context)` to `Navigator.pop(context, true)` (backward compatible — other callers ignore the result).

Run dart format on the file; run flutter analyze and flutter test; fix any issues. Then stage ONLY add_transaction_screen.dart (and the new SmsPrefill file if separate) by name and commit locally with a conventional message (e.g. 'feat(add-tx): add-details disclosure + optional SMS prefill'). Do not push. Record in findings: the final name/location of SmsPrefill and its field list, and the pop(context,true) contract, so FEAT-002 can rely on them.
acceptance_criteria: New Add opens with optional fields collapsed; editing an existing transaction opens with them expanded.
Collapsing/expanding never changes saved data: payment method still defaults to UPI, note/tags/location/receipt values persist across toggles.
Transfer still hides Payment/Account; Cash still hides Account.
AddTransactionScreen(initialType: ...) and AddTransactionScreen(editTransaction: ...) compile and behave exactly as before (smsPrefill defaults null).
With a non-null smsPrefill and no editTransaction, the form seeds amount/type/description/paymentMethod/date and the saved TransactionModel carries source='sms' + smsMessageId + externalReference.
`flutter analyze` reports no new diagnostics for the file; `flutter test` passes (smoke test still finds 'MyKhata').
findings: SmsPrefill is a top-level immutable class defined in lib/presentation/screens/add_transaction/add_transaction_screen.dart (same file as AddTransactionScreen; NOT a separate file), so `import '.../add_transaction/add_transaction_screen.dart';` gives access to both SmsPrefill and AddTransactionScreen. Const constructor: `const SmsPrefill({required String type, required double amount, String? description, String paymentMethod = 'UPI', required DateTime date, String? accountId, String? smsMessageId, String? externalReference})`. Exact final field list in declaration order: String type; double amount; String? description; String paymentMethod (default 'UPI'); DateTime date; String? accountId; String? smsMessageId; String? externalReference. AddTransactionScreen now has `final SmsPrefill? smsPrefill;` as a named const-constructor param defaulting to null; initialType and editTransaction params and behavior are unchanged. SMS seeding runs only when `editTransaction == null && smsPrefill != null`: it seeds _type, amount, description, _selectedPaymentMethod, _selectedDate, and resolves accountId through _effectiveAccount (inserted into the resolution chain after editTransaction/empty-check, before primaryDefault). On that SMS path the saved TransactionModel carries source: 'sms', smsMessageId, externalReference (otherwise source defaults 'manual' and those stay null). SAVE CONTRACT: on a successful save the form now calls `Navigator.pop(context, true)` (truthy result). Cancel/back/validation-failure do NOT pop with true. This is backward compatible — existing callers (edit, pushModal) ignore the result. FEAT-002's SMS single-confirm should open AddTransactionScreen(smsPrefill: ...) via AppRoutes.pushModal, await the bool result, and mark the SMS 'added' only when the awaited result == true.
